subject: Pricing snapshot & supported models for hosted API (per-1M tokens)
messages:
From: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@healtech.ai>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask: per‑1M token IO rates + model list for hosted API

Hi Tessa,

We're kicking off scoping for a narrow POC at HealTech and trying to baseline hosting costs quickly. Could you send your standard per‑1M token pricing (split input vs output) for your hosted API and a short list of the models that are eligible for those standard IO rates? A few clarifying bits that would help: 

- We primarily need instruction/chat models (ability to do tool-calling later) and one embedding model for semantic search.
- Helpful to see sample math for a 3M tokens/month POC (split ~40% input / 60% output).
- Any standard volume discounts or pilot credits you offer for a short-term POC would be great to know.
- Are there model variants (quantized or 32k context) that are excluded from hosted IO tiers?

If you can send a short snapshot or a rate sheet that we can share internally today, that would be ideal. We can follow with a short call if needed — I'm in PST.

Thanks,
Sarah Lowe
Head of ML Platforms
HealTech AI

Attachment: none
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@healtech.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask: per‑1M token IO rates + model list for hosted API

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and congrats on the POC kickoff. See a short snapshot below and I attached our current hosted rate sheet (Redwood-Hosted-Rate-Sheet-Nov2026.pdf).

Baseline hosted IO rates (per 1M tokens) — standard public tiers (no committed discount):
- rw-chat-4k (chat/instruct, 4k context): input $110 / 1M, output $220 / 1M
- rw-chat-32k (chat/instruct, 32k context): input $280 / 1M, output $560 / 1M
- open-instruct-7b (instruction-tuned 7B): input $18 / 1M, output $36 / 1M
- embed-sim-4k (embeddings): $35 / 1M embedding units (note: embeddings billed per embedding unit, not tokens)

Sample math for 3M tokens/month, split 40% input (1.2M) / 60% output (1.8M):
- rw-chat-4k: (1.2M * $110/1M) + (1.8M * $220/1M) = $132 + $396 = $528 (per month)
- rw-chat-32k: (1.2M * $280/1M) + (1.8M * $560/1M) = $336 + $1008 = $1,344 (per month)

Volume discounts (hosted API, applied to IO rates with a single invoice):
- 5M+ tokens/mo: 15% off listed IO rates
- 20M+ tokens/mo: 30% off listed IO rates
- Custom enterprise commits: tiered pricing and SLAs (contact sales engineering for firm quotes)

Pilot/credits:
- We typically offer a pilot credit of 50k tokens for a POC evaluation; we can extend credits for qualified pilots (dependent on a short mutual action plan).

Model eligibility notes:
- Most catalog models above are eligible for hosted IO tiers. Quantized variants (e.g., rw-chat-32k-quant) are usually eligible but sometimes routed to dedicated capacity for performance; that can affect latency SLOs but not the IO rate by default.
- Extremely large or specialized variants (custom finetunes or air-gapped private models) may require Dedicated/Private and are priced separately.

SLO/latency (hosted):
- rw-chat-4k: typical P95 latency <120ms under baseline load
- rw-chat-32k: typical P95 latency <250ms (higher memory/compute)
- If you need consistent sub-100ms P95, we recommend Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) — we can include those numbers in a follow-up.

Next steps: I've attached the rate sheet and can put Marissa (sales engineering) on the thread to look at model-compat details for your planned prompts and token distribution. If you want, book a 30-minute slot here: https://calendly.com/tessa-redwood/30min

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Thanks Tessa — this is super helpful. Quick follow-ups: 

On Wed, Nov 25, 2026 at 4:12 PM Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Baseline hosted IO rates (per 1M tokens) — standard public tiers (no committed discount):

> - rw-chat-32k (chat/instruct, 32k context): input $280 / 1M, output $560 / 1M

We'd likely start with a committed POC of ~5M tokens/month for 60 days (split roughly 35/65 input/output). Two questions: 
1) Would a 5M committed POC fall into the 15% discount band immediately (i.e., applied for the duration of the POC)?
2) Is rw-chat-32k-quant eligible for the hosted IO tier or does it require Dedicated routing?

Also — can you confirm whether the IO rate includes streaming token overheads (we do a lot of streaming responses)?

If the answers are yes/yes and streaming is included, we can sign the basic MSA and move to a small commit. Can you loop Marissa in so we can get a quick technical green light?

Appreciate it,
Sarah
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask: per‑1M token IO rates + model list for hosted API

Thanks — quick answers inline and looping Marissa: 

1) 5M committed POC: yes, that sits in the 5M+ band so the 15% discount applies for the committed period. We apply the commit discount at invoice time for the billing period that meets the threshold.

2) rw-chat-32k-quant: typically eligible for hosted IO tiers. In some high-concurrency cases we route quant variants to Dedicated for performance, but that is an operational routing decision not an IO-rate restriction.

Streaming overhead: standard streaming token emission is included in IO billing. We bill by tokens emitted/consumed by the API — there's no separate streaming surcharge.

Marissa — can you confirm any technical caveats for rw-chat-32k-quant with a HealTech prompt set and whether we should recommend Dedicated for the 60-day pilot? If it's borderline we can propose a short Dedicated burst window in the MAP.

I'll draft a short MAP and an MSA addendum for a 5M/month, 60-day pilot and share the DocuSign link once we have a green light.

Thanks,
Tessa

- For your prompt mix (clinical summarization + triage), token counts trend slightly higher on outputs — the sample math Tessa gave aligns well.
- If you want, send a redacted sample prompt set and I can run a quick simulator against rw-chat-4k and rw-chat-32k-quant to show expected per-request token profile and latency.
